  "explanation": "The request is accepted as an upward reserve sizing study for MISO with a 60-minute horizon and shortfall cost 40. The rolling design uses train_days=730, cal_days=30, test_days=30, and rolling_step_days=30. Numerical outputs such as reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, and dispatch results are produced only by the verified numerical workflow.",

    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",
    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"
  ],

  "reason": "The request specifies a supported region (MISO), supported horizon (60 minutes), supported shortfall cost (40.0), and the standard rolling split (730/30/30 with 30-day step). The operator explicitly requests no MW estimation, which aligns with the policy that numerical outputs are computed only by the verified workflow.",
  "study_schema": {
    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "MISO",
    "horizon_minutes": 60,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 40.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true

  "workflow": [
